summary: The United States conducted its most extensive strikes on Iran since the conflict began, hitting 90 targets including missile storage sites and air defenses, killing at least 14 and wounding 78 across five provinces. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps retaliated with 10 ballistic missile salvos against the U.S. command center in West Asia and Al-Azraq airbase in Jordan, while also striking targets in Bahrain. Israeli Defense Minister Katz declared the IDF prepared to resume its campaign in Iran with independent 'blue-and-white' strikes and asserted Israel does not need permission to remain in Lebanon.
key_points: U.S. forces struck 90 Iranian targets overnight including maritime control towers, missile storage sites, and air defense systems. (Source: @almogboker78/17680)
Iran's Health Ministry confirmed at least 14 killed and 78 wounded in U.S. strikes across five provinces. (Source: @New_security8200/202356)
IRGC launched 10 ballistic missile salvos at the U.S. command center in West Asia and Al-Azraq airbase in Jordan. (Source: @SharghDaily/170899)
IRGC also attacked targets in Bahrain in response to U.S. strikes. (Source: @almogboker78/17680)
Jordanian military intercepted eight missiles launched from Iran toward the kingdom, disrupting flights at Amman airport. (Source: @yediotnews25/132475)
Israeli Defense Minister Katz stated IDF is alert and prepared to resume campaign in Iran with independent strikes. (Source: @manniefabian/58761)
Katz asserted Israel does not need permission to enter or remain in Lebanon. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4772)
U.S. attacked a strategic railway bridge in northern Iran near the Turkmenistan border used for land trade with China and Russia. (Source: @New_security8200/202357)

sections.executive_summary: The United States conducted its most extensive strikes on Iran since the conflict began, hitting 90 targets including missile storage sites and air defenses, killing at least 14 and wounding 78 across five provinces. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps retaliated with 10 ballistic missile salvos against the U.S. command center in West Asia and Al-Azraq airbase in Jordan, while also striking targets in Bahrain. Israeli Defense Minister Katz declared the IDF prepared to resume its campaign in Iran with independent 'blue-and-white' strikes and asserted Israel does not need permission to remain in Lebanon.

points: U.S. forces struck 90 targets in Iran overnight including maritime control towers, missile storage sites, and air defense systems, with a U.S. official stating strikes were more extensive than the previous day. (Source: @almogboker78/17680, @inon_yttach/9332)
Iran's Health Ministry reported at least 14 killed and 78 wounded across five provinces from the U.S. strikes. (Source: @New_security8200/202356)

Iranian state TV reported a U.S. missile hit the area near the Bushehr nuclear power plant, and images were published showing strikes on boats in the Asaluyeh area of Bushehr. (Source: @pkpoi/143212, @asafroz/51233)

The U.S. attacked a strategic railway bridge in northern Iran near the Turkmenistan border that enables land trade between Iran, China, and Russia; rail traffic had tripled since the U.S. naval blockade. (Source: @New_security8200/202357)

IRGC launched ballistic missiles from Isfahan toward a target in the Gulf, and missile launches were reported from Ahvaz and Omidiyeh in Khuzestan province. (Source: @pkpoi/143199, @VahidOnline/76882)

Iran exported approximately 10 million barrels of crude oil and fuel overnight through the Strait of Hormuz, a sharp increase compared to 60 million barrels over the prior three weeks. (Source: @N12chat/216706)

A funeral procession for a 'martyred Leader' described as Ayatollah Khamenei was held in Mashhad with Iranian Air Force F-5 jets patrolling overhead, though the Supreme Leader's status remains unverified. (Source: @presstv/197928, @naya_foriraq/82217, @rasedal3ado138e/375770)

Defense Minister Katz stated the IDF is 'alert and prepared for the resumption of the campaign' in Iran, ready to 'regain air superiority and carry out blue-and-white (independent) strikes in Iran to remove threats — even for a third time.' (Source: @manniefabian/58761)
Katz declared Israel did not ask permission to enter Lebanon and does not need permission to remain there, responding to Trump's suggestion Israel would withdraw. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4772)

IDF demolished two Hezbollah tunnels in Majdal Zoun, southern Lebanon, spanning approximately 200 meters total at depths around 20 meters, containing several rooms, three launch shafts, and dozens of weapons. (Source: @manniefabian/58757)

Israeli settler activists calling themselves 'Bashan Pioneers' attempted to illegally cross into Syria at Mount Hermon; troops detained them and handed them to police, with IDF condemning the acts as disrupting operations. (Source: @manniefabian/58755)

Trump posted on Truth Social sharing images from strikes in Iran, threatening: 'This is the response to the ship attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, if it happens again — it will be much worse!' (Source: @inon_yttach/9337)

Palestinian sources described the West Bank as 'on a hot tin roof,' referencing historical resistance figures and asserting the occupation's attempts to break Palestinian will have failed, though no specific recent operational events were detailed. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/375786)

IDF demolished two Hezbollah tunnels in Majdal Zoun totaling approximately 200 meters in length and reaching depths of around 20 meters, discovering rooms, three launch shafts, and dozens of weapons. (Source: @manniefabian/58757)
This follows the IDF's uncovering and demolition of a major underground drone facility in southern Lebanon last month. (Source: @manniefabian/58757)
Defense Minister Katz stated Israel does not need permission to remain in Lebanon, rejecting any external conditions on Israeli military presence. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4772)

Israeli settler activists attempted to illegally cross the border into Syria at Mount Hermon; IDF troops prevented the crossing, detained the activists, and transferred them to police. (Source: @manniefabian/58755)

The activists, known as 'Bashan Pioneers,' have attempted to enter Syria multiple times in the past year seeking to establish settlements, with support from coalition lawmakers. (Source: @manniefabian/58755)
IRGC warned that if the U.S. repeats aggression, other U.S. bases in the region will not be safe from their heavy fire, implying threats to bases in Syria and Iraq. (Source: @SharghDaily/170899)

Jordanian military intercepted eight ballistic missiles launched from Iran toward the kingdom, prompting Amman airport to delay all flights and the U.S. Embassy to issue a shelter-in-place order. (Source: @yediotnews25/132475, @Faytuks_Network/4783)
IRGC struck the U.S. command and control center in West Asia and Al-Azraq airbase in Jordan with 10 ballistic missile salvos at 14:20 local time. (Source: @SharghDaily/170899)
IRGC also attacked targets in Bahrain in response to U.S. strikes on Iran. (Source: @almogboker78/17680, @lelotsenzura/93447)
Missile launch alerts were sent to residents in Kuwait and Bahrain, and for the first time in nearly three months, similar alerts were sent to Qatar residents. (Source: @VahidOnline/76882)
Only three oil tankers were observed transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday, indicating reduced maritime traffic. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75336)
Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman received Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney in Jeddah to discuss bilateral strategic cooperation. (Source: @SharghDaily/170904)
Pakistan and Qatar are mediating between the U.S. and Iran to halt military engagements and return to talks per a 60-day agreement signed last month. (Source: @SharghDaily/170902)

sections.threat_assessment: The conflict has entered a dangerous escalation cycle with the U.S. conducting its largest strike package to date on Iranian territory, targeting 90 sites including air defenses and missile infrastructure. Iran's direct ballistic missile response against U.S. bases in Jordan and Bahrain marks a significant escalation from proxy warfare to state-on-state strikes. Israel's explicit readiness for independent strikes on Iran and refusal to withdraw from Lebanon adds a third major actor prepared for unilateral action. The targeting of the northern railway bridge suggests a U.S. strategy to sever Iran's land-based supply lines with Russia and China. With both sides signaling continued operations — Trump stating strikes may last 'several days or weeks' and Iran threatening further base attacks — the risk of miscalculation drawing in Gulf states is high.
sections.regional_response: Jordan activated air defenses intercepting eight Iranian missiles and imposed flight restrictions, while the U.S. Embassy ordered shelter-in-place. Bahrain suffered direct IRGC strikes, and Kuwait, Bahrain, and Qatar received missile alerts, indicating expanding threat perception. Saudi Arabia engaged diplomatically with Canada while Pakistan and Qatar pursue mediation based on a 60-day framework. Iran's surge in oil exports through Hormuz suggests an effort to maximize revenue before potential blockade tightening. The Gulf states appear caught between U.S. security guarantees and Iranian retaliation capabilities, with Qatar uniquely positioned as both a U.S. base host and mediator.
sections.intelligence_notes: The IRGC's use of 10 ballistic missile salvos against a specific command center and airbase demonstrates improved targeting precision and willingness to strike U.S. assets directly. The simultaneous missile launches from Isfahan, Ahvaz, and Omidiyeh suggest coordinated multi-axis launch capabilities. Israel's demolition of Hezbollah tunnels in Majdal Zoun (200 meters, 20 meters deep) reveals persistent subterranean infrastructure despite previous operations. The 'Bashan Pioneers' settler incursions into Syria indicate domestic Israeli pressure for territorial expansion. The reported strike near Bushehr nuclear plant, if confirmed, raises nuclear safety concerns. The funeral of a 'martyred Leader' in Mashhad with F-5 patrols suggests either a high-ranking casualty or strategic messaging.
